stories.title: The one-small-idea machine
stories.basis: Inspired by Ferret's many projects, DJing, fishing and the Accord's right to rest.
panels: One small idea. Nothing that needs its own shed.
By the second cup of tea.
A book! A game! A farm! A waterproof disco for carp!
Good news: I've cleared the desk. Bad news: I can't find the house.
Ferret off duty. The fish can chair the next meeting.

stories.title: The Chairperson takes the bait
stories.kicker: JO  CALM IN A SEA OF NONSENSE
stories.basis: Inspired by Jo's real fishing trips and her Chairperson role. The dialogue and splash are invented.
panels: Today's agenda: sit down, cast out, enjoy ourselves.
That's a very strong objection from the floor of the pond!
Lovely fish. No speech, please-we'll get you straight back.
The motion carries. Quite a lot of water.
Meeting adjourned. The chair has been thoroughly briefed.

stories.title: The case of the warmer cushion
stories.basis: Inspired by Arthur's Chief Justice persona and fondness for the warmest spot.
panels: The court must determine which cushion is mine.
This one is soft. Suspiciously soft.
I shall occupy both until bias can be ruled out.
Judgment is reserved. So are the cushions.
The appeal will be heard after his afternoon nap. Possibly Thursday.

stories.title: Long live the box!
stories.basis: character. This royal box dispute is fictional.
panels: Excellent craftsmanship. Remove the expensive chair from behind it.
His Majesty tests the royal residence.
A snug palace. Very low council tax.
Bring me the smaller box. This one has a spare bedroom.
The throne became a coat rack. The monarchy saved a fortune.

stories.title: A very quiet warning
stories.basis: Inspired by Tilly's quiet, shy character and formidable boundaries.
panels: At last. A plot that doesn't involve anybody shouting.
CLANG! I AM THE FUTURE OF HOME ENTERTAINMENT!
And this is the present of the off switch.
You're a natural at silent service. More tea?

stories.title: The sofa inspection
stories.basis: Inspired by Trixie's stern parade-ground persona. No real military figure is depicted.
panels: Cushions straight. Tassels tucked. Not a crumb out of line.
One recruit fails to stand up.
That cushion is leaning. This is a sofa, not a seaside holiday.
Observe the correct resting position. I shall model it personally.
The unit was ordered to remain perfectly still for three hours.

stories.title: The wolf who wouldn't boo
stories.basis: Inspired by Dexter's wolf-like appearance and gentle temperament.
panels: Right. Big entrance. Terrifying silhouette. Very serious paws.
Morning. Is this the way to the pond?
Oh! Yes. After you. Mind the little step.
A fearsome reputation takes a new direction.
By lunchtime he was running the nicest escort service in Lancashire.

stories.title: The perfectly innocent biscuit
stories.basis: persona. No real biscuit theft is alleged.
panels: The biscuit tin is under guard.
Me? I'm simply admiring the lid.
If a biscuit falls in a kitchen, does anyone hear it?
That's not theft. That's an unauthorised crumb migration.
I'll watch the empty tin. You go and fetch another one.
